summary: Blocked after the fresh page-33 upper-edge crop included part of the following design note beyond the authorized initial continuation block.
authorized_scope: Only the initial continuation of the last page-32 block on physical page 33; no subsequent block.

actual_access.operation: Serial local crop PDF, text extraction, PNG rendering and visual inspection.
actual_access.overread: The crop included the continuation and part of the following design note. Additional source content is not reproduced in this incident record.

cause: The initial crop lower boundary was estimated before inspection and extended beyond the continuation paragraph.
impact: The session has observed source content outside its bounded authorization. Source-access gates remain binding; the session cannot supply a clean inventory delivery.
smallest_resolution: Assess the scoped incident and prepare a fresh executor session with exact page-33 continuation bounds. Preserve this attempt as immutable and unaccepted; authorize any reuse explicitly.
